newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Minsur stock split to increase shrs 145 pct.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Minsur stock split to increase shrs 145 pct.

text.p: Peru's Minsur SA, the world's third largest tin producer and a Lima stock exchange bluechip, has agreed to a share split that will increase the number of its shares in circulation by 145.5 percent, the stock exchange said Monday.
The split will increase the number of Minsur's shares in circulation to 60.6 million from 24.7 million, the Lima bolsa said in its daily report.
The tin miner has not yet announced when it will distribute the new shares.
Monday, Minsur's stock was trading around 22.20 soles per share on the Lima exchange around 1400 local time/1900 GMT, five hours into the eight-hour session.
Minsur operates the San Rafael mine in Peru's southern highlands.
